'''Augara "Augie" Jowil''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[musikagung]] who led the [[Great Municipal Band/Legends|Great Municipal Band]] during the [[Republic Classic era]]. Hailing from the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Jowil was sent by her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to study under famous [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. Pert was the leader of the Great Municipal Band at the [[Time/Legends|time]], and when he chose to retire, the other [[Band/Legends|band]] members elected Jowil to be his successor, in spite of her youth. The young Gungan took to the task enthusiastically and propelled the band to new fame in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when she composed the "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]," which was played in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the victory celebrations after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

==Biography==
Augara Jowil, or "Augie" as she was known, had been raised in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] region. She demonstrated significant talent as a [[musikagung]] at an early age, and was hailed as a prodigy. Jowil was sent by her parents to [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], where she studied<ref name="db" /> for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|175|Jowil, Augarra "Augie"}}</ref> under [[Great Municipal Band/Legends|Great Municipal Band]] leader [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]], composer of the famed "[[Symponika Crunchen-Grand]]," which chronicled the original formation of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="db" /> Jowil was among the first to hear the "Symponika Crunchen-Grand."<ref name="CSWE" /> After finishing Jowil's instruction, Pert retired, and the members of the band unanimously voted in his young pupil as his successor, despite her youth and inexperience.<ref name="db" />

[[File:Gunganfemale.jpg|thumb|left|Augara witnesses the summit at the Sacred Place.]]
In her new role, Jowil never believed that she would be given the opportunity to chronicle anything as significant as the formation of the Gungan Grand Army.<ref name="db" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Naboo was invaded by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], forcing [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] to evacuate Otoh Gunga. Jowil joined Nass and the [[Rep/Legends|Reps]] at the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Sacred Place]] some time after the evacuation, and was there to witness [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], leader of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population on Naboo, present herself before Nass in a bid to forge an alliance against the Federation. Nass agreed, and prepared to send the Gungan Grand Army to fight the invaders.<ref name="tpm" /> Jowil was stunned by the humility and respect of Amidala and her Human entourage, and she realized that what she had just seen would be a watershed moment in Naboo's history.<ref name="db" />

With a fitting subject now at hand, Jowil set about composing, in her head, a piece that would chronicle what she had just seen. In a matter of days, she had composed the "[[Symponik Nabooalla]]," an epic for all of Naboo's denizens<ref name="db" /> chronicling the Gungans' and Humans' collaborative efforts at restoring their freedom.<ref name="CSWE" /> The first movement of the piece debuted during a large parade in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], in which Humans and Gungans alike had overcome the armies of the Federation. Among those present were [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], in addition to Queen Amidala and Boss Nass.<ref name="tpm" /> The exposure that the piece received was unprecedented, cementing Jowil's place in history as one of the Great Municipal Band's most significant leaders.<ref name="db" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the rebelling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jowil, along with several other prominent Naboo musicians, coaxed Beezar Pert out of retirement for a special concert in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] of Theed to honor the orphans of both Republic and Separatist forces.<ref name="blog">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
An individual of considerable talent, Augara Jowil was thrust into the important role of Great Municipal Band leader at an early age. Despite her inexperience, she acquitted herself well in the role, and pushed the band to new fame. Jowil was also very perceptive, as she predicted the significance of the makeshift summit at the Sacred Palace in 32 BBY.<ref name="db" /> Jowil had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="tpm" /> and skin that was pinkish-orange and beige in color, and stood 1.85 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Augara Jowil first appeared in [[George Lucas]]' [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] as a background character late in the film.<ref name="tpm" /> She was later identified and elaborated on by [[Chad Finke]], via [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]" Finke's entry, published in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]], identified the Gungan as "Augie"<ref name="db" /> from the track title "Augie's Great Municipal Band"&mdash;the final track on the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (soundtrack)|original soundtrack of ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM OST">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (soundtrack)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' soundtrack]]</ref> The entry was added to the Databank on [[January 12]], [[2007]].<ref name="jan12">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20070112.html|text=What's the Story: Episode I}}</ref> Jowil's first name was misspelled "Augura" in the [[March 27]], [[2008]] update to the Databank, titled "What's the Story: The Fans Set The Facts."<ref name="Fans">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20080321.html|text=What's the Story: The Fans Set the Facts}}</ref> The character later received an entry in the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> released on [[December 9]], 2008,<ref name="CSWEreleasedate">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> though her entry misspelled her first name "Augarra."<ref name="CSWE" />
